class.name: GaussianSplatRegionVolume3D
class.brief_description: Names a region at bake time.
class.description: Assigns a region to every matching splat centre. PLY region ids keep their numbers and manifest names [code]ply_<id>[/code]. Volume ids start above the maximum reserved PLY or existing manifest id and are allocated in sorted node-path order, up to 65,535; exhaustion fails with [code]semantic_region_id_exhausted[/code]. Volume ids are NOT stable across edits: adding a volume can renumber others. Game code must resolve regions by NAME through the persisted [code]regions[][/code] manifest, never by a hard-coded numeric id. Semantic input without wind input has valid semantics and wind weight zero, so it does not sway.

members.member: Manifest name; an empty string uses the node name. Duplicate region names are refused.
